headline: Maui County Independent Nomination Board

meeting.summary: The Independent Nomination Board reviewed 2025 nomination applicants in closed session and chose people to interview, including for the Housing Advisory Board.
meeting.recap: The board voted to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion) to review applications for 2025 mass nominations.[[0:02:26]] The board returned to open session at 6:21 p.m.[[0:03:49]] The chair reported that members voted to interview one more Housing Advisory Board candidate at the next meeting.[[0:04:09]] Members picked four applicants to interview for a planning commission whose name is unclear in the captions.[[0:04:27]] Members voted to interview two applicants for the Urban Design Review Board.[[0:05:07]] The board expects many written questions from that commission.[[0:08:09]] Staff described a letter from the Office of Council Services director proposing an ordinance to address board vacancies.[[0:10:15]] Staff said no action on that ordinance will be taken until 2025.[[0:10:40]] Staff said all council members supported the proposal.[[0:11:14]] The next meeting is December 11.[[0:15:12]] Members were told remote attendance is the best option because it will be hard to hear in the meeting room.[[0:15:46]] Interviews are expected to take up much of the next meeting.[[0:20:32]]
meeting.next: An ordinance on vacancies may be drafted, with action in 2025 when the new term begins. The board plans one more final review of any additional applications that come in.

moments.q: Vote to go into executive session
